name: Team infrastructure
description: health, provision (MCP token, repository checkout, registration with the product office), pause, resume, status push

name: Product owner
description: state of the module through the coding agent (read-only), the proposal brief, the requirement brief

name: Architect
description: design brief, the spec catalog mirroring the code (places and link transitions), the context pack, the policy gate

name: QA
description: acceptance brief, verification on the real suites with evidence, the production-readiness audit

name: Developer
description: implement through the coding agent on a branch, the review brief, the merge on the person's decision

name: Team brain
description: observe a merge, curate facts, plan, decisions, questions and ideas, apply the curation, push the release to the office
